description: Sends a problem report or suggestion to Carryo. Call only when the user asks to share feedback with Carryo. Send a concise message and only relevant context they intend to share; never automatically attach conversation history, website contents, or credentials. Common secrets are redacted, but redaction is not comprehensive. Requires a connected Carryo account. The complete request is limited to 32 KiB. Returns a receipt after saving; a reply is not guaranteed. Do not automatically retry an uncertain outcome because another submission may create a duplicate.

context.description: Optional relevant details, such as tool, expected behavior, and actual behavior. Include only details the user intends to share.

message.description: Feedback the user wants to share with Carryo. Include a specific problem or suggestion; omit credentials, secrets, and full conversations.

name: submit_feedback

feedbackId.description: Receipt identifier for the saved feedback

message.description: Submission acknowledgement; a reply is not guaranteed

title: Submit Feedback to Carryo
